def calc_c5(h):
    n = len(h)
    # compute linear convolution via FFT
    nfft = 1 << ((2*n - 1).bit_length())
    H = np.fft.rfft(h, n=nfft)
    B = np.fft.rfft(1 - h, n=nfft)
    conv = np.fft.irfft(H * B, n=nfft)[:2*n-1]
    return np.max(conv) * dx

def compute_c5(h):
    # compute correlation via FFT
    n=len(h)
    nfft = 1<<((2*n-1).bit_length())
    H = np.fft.rfft(h, nfft)
    B = np.fft.rfft(1-h, nfft)
    conv = np.fft.irfft(H * B, n=nfft)[:2*n-1]
    return np.max(conv) * (2.0 / n)
